description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Precursor Golem.
When Precursor Golem enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Golems, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Golems.
